title: Dr Frost Arctic Mango Pineapple Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Shortfill Mango Pineapple Ice delivers a vibrant tropical fusion of juicy Mango and tangy Pineapple, perfectly finished with a frosty menthol exhale. This lively and refreshing blend balances sweetness with sharp, fruity notes, making it a top choice for vapers who enjoy bold, exotic e-liquid profiles. As part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this shortfill features double-concentrated ‘Bar Salts’ flavour, replicating the bold taste found in disposable vapes. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s designed for low-powered Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits. The 100ml bottle provides space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing users to tailor their nicotine strength or enjoy it nicotine-free. Dr Frost Arctic Shortfills are a versatile and economical option for adult smokers and vapers seeking exceptional flavour and value.
